Name: Seasonal Linus Foliage

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Are you as much of a fan of Linus's winter outfit as I am? Well have I got the mod for you! [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This is going to eventually be a part of the seasonal update for my medieval villagers mod. I'm not going to make individual mods for every single character like this, but for Linus, I made an exception because I feel like his design in particular can be enjoyed outside of a medieval playthrough.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Content Patcher and SMAPI[/size][/color]
